brz_curator.text: This is the heritage hangar. We keep a few of the old types alive for the station's history, and there's a Horsa glider in the corner, which looks like a flying shed because it was one.
A Horsa has no engine. It was towed up by a bomber and cast off over the field, and the pilot had one go at the landing. The pilots were wonderfully brave and a bit mad.

brz_volunteer.text: I do Tuesdays. I dust the VC10 poster and I tell visitors it was the quietest jet ever built. That is a lie, and the VC10 knows it.
Here, have a mint. They're from the NAAFI, they're older than the Atlas, and they are still very good.
